releases.summary: Icon toggle panel images are smaller: 110px on every screen size (was 150px). Taken from a migrated page that had kept this size as its own override.

changes.summary: The image in an Icon toggle panel is 110px wide on every screen size, instead of 150px.
changes.notes: Replace the Icon toggle block's CSS. A page that sized its panel images itself in its own overrides can drop that override.

releases.summary: The greys are named for what they are used for (--divider-colour, --secondary-text-colour, --hover-background, --tile-border-colour). --dark-grey, --light-grey and --mid-grey still work, as aliases, until 3.6.0. No visual change.

changes.summary: New tokens --divider-colour, --secondary-text-colour, --hover-background and --tile-border-colour, which the base CSS now uses for the breadcrumb divider, the breadcrumb's current page, the timestamp and the contents hover. --dark-grey, --light-grey and --mid-grey are kept as aliases of them. The colours are unchanged.
changes.notes: Replace the base CSS and the CSS of every block on the page together: the blocks now read the new tokens, so mixing versions would leave those colours undefined.

changes.summary: The Icon toggle tile border uses var(--tile-border-colour).
changes.notes: Replace the base CSS and the CSS of every block on the page together: the blocks now read the new tokens, so mixing versions would leave those colours undefined.

releases.summary: Neutral colours are tokens named for what they are used for (--page-background, --text-on-primary, --subheading-colour, --card-text-colour, --focus-ring-colour, --panel-background, --shadow-colour, --floating-button-background), instead of hard-coded values. No visual change, except that nav-card headings are black instead of #1a1a1a.

changes.summary: The base CSS defines the usage-named neutral colour tokens, and uses them for the page background, the contents heading text, the content-column sub-headings and the back-to-top button. The colours are unchanged.
changes.notes: Replace the base CSS and the CSS of every block on the page together: the blocks now read the new tokens, so mixing versions would leave those colours undefined.

changes.summary: The accordion focus ring uses var(--focus-ring-colour).
changes.notes: Replace the base CSS and the CSS of every block on the page together: the blocks now read the new tokens, so mixing versions would leave those colours undefined.

changes.summary: The At a glance panel background uses var(--panel-background).
changes.notes: Replace the base CSS and the CSS of every block on the page together: the blocks now read the new tokens, so mixing versions would leave those colours undefined.

changes.summary: Button text uses var(--text-on-primary).
changes.notes: Replace the base CSS and the CSS of every block on the page together: the blocks now read the new tokens, so mixing versions would leave those colours undefined.

changes.summary: Icon toggle tile shadows use var(--shadow-colour). The shadows look the same.
changes.notes: Replace the base CSS and the CSS of every block on the page together: the blocks now read the new tokens, so mixing versions would leave those colours undefined.

changes.summary: Nav card text, button text and shadow use var(--card-text-colour), var(--text-on-primary) and var(--shadow-colour). The headings of numbered cards were #1a1a1a and are now black, like the card text.
changes.notes: Replace the base CSS and the CSS of every block on the page together: the blocks now read the new tokens, so mixing versions would leave those colours undefined.

changes.summary: Resource card shadows use var(--shadow-colour). The hover shadow was a different near-black (26, 26, 26) and is now the same shadow colour as the others: a difference nobody can see.
changes.notes: Replace the base CSS and the CSS of every block on the page together: the blocks now read the new tokens, so mixing versions would leave those colours undefined.

releases.summary: Icon toggle tiles show the pointer cursor on the tile itself.

changes.summary: The Icon toggle tile (.data-icon-card) sets the pointer cursor itself. Before, only its wrapper (.data-icon-trigger) did, so tiles built with older markup, which has no trigger class, did not look clickable.
changes.notes: Replace the Icon toggle block's CSS (inside #page-container). Pages built with the current markup look the same either way, because the cursor was already inherited from the wrapper.

releases.summary: Section block gets a "directly below the page title" option (the tight-heading class), and the At a glance heading keeps its theme colour.

changes.summary: New Section option: "This section comes directly below the page title". When ticked the heading gets class="tight-heading", which closes the gap under the H1.
changes.notes: Off by default, so existing sections are unchanged. The class needs base CSS 3.2.0 or later. To use it on an existing page, replace the base CSS, then add class="tight-heading" to the H2 by hand or rebuild the section.

changes.summary: The At a glance heading sets its own theme colour. In 3.2.0 the content-column H3 became black, which also turned this heading black.
changes.notes: Replace the At a glance block's CSS (inside #page-container) together with the base CSS. Pages still on a base before 3.2.0 are themed already; this keeps them themed once they take the new base.

releases.summary: Base CSS refinements (numbered lists, sub-heading colour, wider contents column, bordered contents items, a tight-heading class) and a visible keyboard focus ring on the Accordion.

changes.summary: Numbered lists get the same vertical spacing as paragraphs and bullet lists, and their numbers are bold.
changes.notes: Replace the base CSS. Adds margin-block: 1em on ol and a bold ::marker on ol > li. The breadcrumb list is unaffected: it resets its own margin and has no markers.

changes.summary: Sub-headings (H3) in the content column are black instead of the theme colour.
changes.notes: Replace the base CSS. Only the plain .content-column h3 changes. Image and text sections and accordion buttons set their own colour and are unchanged.

changes.summary: New .tight-heading class: put it on an H2 that sits directly below the page title (H1) to close the gap between them.
changes.notes: Pages without it are unaffected. To use it on an existing page, replace the base CSS first, then add class="tight-heading" to the H2 (h2.tight-heading). The base H1 margin is deliberately unchanged, so pages with an At a glance box keep their spacing.

changes.summary: The contents column is a little wider (1.3fr to 3fr instead of 1fr to 3fr), so long contents labels wrap less.
changes.notes: Replace the base CSS. Pages built without a contents list are unaffected (they only have the single-column rule, so they are not flagged).

changes.summary: Contents items get a 1px border in the theme colour.
changes.notes: Replace the base CSS. The background stays on var(--secondary-colour) so both themes keep their own tint.

changes.summary: Accordion buttons show a visible black focus ring for keyboard users. The block removed Bootstrap's own focus shadow, which left nothing visible.
changes.notes: Replace the Accordion block's CSS (inside #page-container). Pages are only affected if they use the Accordion.

releases.summary: Patch: the page container background is set explicitly to white, so the supplier's grey default no longer shows.

changes.summary: The #page-container background is set to white. The supplier's default page background changed to grey, so pages built on the base CSS showed grey.
changes.notes: Replace the base CSS. In the #page-container block, background-color must be white !important. Pages on 3.1.0 have it as transparent, which is the line to change.

releases.summary: First set of updates on version 3.0.0: colour tokens, theme toggle, two-column block, mobile layout fixes, ordered list numbering, link rel handling, back-to-top icon, nav card and upgrade tooling.

changes.summary: Colour tokens renamed to the template's names: --navy, --green and --burgundy become --primary-colour; --tertiary-colour becomes --secondary-colour. The old --secondary-colour (navy) is removed, so the name --secondary-colour now means a different colour.
changes.notes: Pages are self-consistent with their own pasted CSS, so they only break if base CSS and block CSS are mixed from different versions. Replace the base CSS and the CSS of every block on the page together. No deprecation aliases existed for this change, so it cannot be done gradually. Note that --secondary-colour changed meaning. It is not a detection pattern, because new pages use it too: check pages that set it by hand.

changes.summary: Ordered lists show their numbers again. The platform strips them from <ol> elements, so the base CSS now restores decimal numbering.
changes.notes: Only pages with ordered lists are affected.

changes.summary: Double quotes in headings, labels, URLs and alt text are now escaped. Previously they broke the generated attributes.
changes.notes: Only pages containing a double quote in an attribute value are affected. Replace each such quote with ". Most pages have none.

changes.summary: rel="noopener noreferrer" is now added only to external links opening in a new tab. Internal links keep target="_blank" alone.
changes.notes: Older pages still carry rel on internal links. That is harmless, so no page change is needed.

changes.summary: The back-to-top button uses the Font Awesome circle-chevron-up icon, coloured with the primary colour, instead of an image.
changes.notes: Requires Font Awesome 7, which the base HTML already loads.

changes.summary: Flexible content: images are vertically centred on desktop, and on mobile they stack image-first, at 3:2, full width and centred.
changes.notes: Copy the block's CSS. The HTML is unchanged.

changes.summary: Image-text: on mobile, 3:2 images are full width, centred and show the top of the image.
changes.notes: Copy the block's CSS. The HTML is unchanged.

changes.summary: New two-column layout block, with media on the left by default and a flip option.
changes.notes: Existing pages are unaffected. Pages can adopt the block when they are next edited.

changes.summary: Buttons: fixed 250px width by default, centred and wrapping. Inside a two-column or flexible-content block they are full width and stacked.
changes.notes: Copy the block's CSS. The HTML is unchanged.

changes.summary: Nav cards: link URL and new-tab settings are shared between the two styles. Generate warns when a style has no usable cards.
changes.notes: Form change only. Output is unchanged.

changes.summary: Base HTML, CSS and JS carry a version header, and the page container carries data-base-version.
changes.notes: Pages without the marker are checked against the version chosen in the upgrade tab.

releases.summary: ORIGIN. The information-hub template page (leadershipportal.thinqi-uat.co.uk/templates/information-hub) as received. Its code is stored unmodified in baseline/3.0.0/. Every later change is recorded against this point.
